_readme: The Scavenger Game from the Scavengers chapter: twelve questions, each moving a marker clockwise or anticlockwise round a dial of ten points, starting at point 1. Questions, options and moves are from the book (pages 61 and 62); the answers and the treasure's grid reference are from the book's answer page (page 234). The ending checks out: the right answers finish on point 8, which the book says leads to the X at grid reference I, 9. Mark reviews.

questions.text: How many times does the letter F appear in the sentence below? "When I visited Phil, finches of Japan were flying around the flourishing bonsai placed on the left of the lounge's entry."
On a standard traffic light, is the green light at the top or the bottom?
questions.why: The green light is at the bottom.

questions.text: How many curves are there on a paper clip?
questions.why: A paper clip has three curves.

questions.text: In which hand is the Statue of Liberty's torch?
questions.why: The torch is in her right hand.

questions.text: How many sides are there on a standard pencil?
questions.why: A standard pencil has six sides.

questions.text: Do books have even-numbered pages on the right or the left side?
questions.why: Even-numbered pages are on the left-hand side.

questions.text: On the American flag, is the top stripe red or white?
On a typical phone keypad, which of these number keys has no letters on it?
questions.why: There are no letters on the 1.

questions.text: When you walk, does your right arm swing with your right leg or your left leg?
questions.why: Your right arm swings with your left leg.

questions.text: Which card in a pack of playing cards carries the manufacturer's trademark?
questions.why: The ace of spades carries the trademark.

questions.text: How many differences are there between these two pictures?
questions.imageAlt: Two pictures of the same cartoon character that differ in five places.
